messages:
andrew: FYI grabbed an nsys capture from the latest canary run. seeing repeating phasing: prefetch -> long idle -> many tiny matmuls. looks like kernel routing keeps switching lanes.
perf-bot: nsys artifact: /artifacts/nsys/2365004321/capture.qdrep
mia: timeline shows KV sweep spikes (~5-7ms) just before the idle gap on multiple iterations. suspect sweep order evicts hot entries then prefetch tries to re-warm.
zia: ran a tighter capture command to isolate kernels: ```nsys profile --output=c2365 --trace=cuda,nvtx --capture-range=cudaProfilerApi ./bin/infer --batch-size 8 --warmup 40 --iters 150``` full view: https://perf.local/2365/capture.html
lila: perfetto snippet: ```GPU: prefetch_kernel(2.1ms) -> idle(11.8ms) -> matmul_micro(0.25ms x 20) -> prefetch_kernel(2.1ms)``` repeating ~100-130ms
dan: initial thought: prefetch heats memory layout so the JIT picks a small-kernel path, but continuous batching mixes request sizes causing many microbatches.
ia: (bot) route-analytics: seq_len_mode=50, p75=78, p95=150, arrival_p50=20ms
mia: test patch I tried in staging: disable prefetch + shrink continuous window.
mia: runtime yaml used: ```serving:\n  batching:\n    continuous_window_ms: 30\n    max_batch_size: 16\n  prefetch:\n    enabled: false\n  kv_cache:\n    sweep_interval_ms: 500\n    sweep_immediate_on_insert: true\n``` results: queue gaps reduced but token latency variance increased.
andrew: so prefetch reduces high variance but introduces kernel flip + idle bursts. maybe alignment/stride differences change kernel selection.
zia: kernel table from ncu: "prefetch":2.0ms, SM=12, bw=5GB/s; "matmul_micro":0.28ms, SM=8; "matmul_full":1.9ms, SM=32, bw=28GB/s. majority of dispatches land on matmul_micro.
lila: hypothesis: continuous_window_ms interacts with arrival patterns so we often form many small cohorts which pick micro matmul. prefetch toggles memory layout and biases kernel routing.
dan: plan proposal — run controlled matrix: (A) prefetch on, window 40; (B) prefetch off, window 40; (C) prefetch on, window 20; (D) prefetch off, window 20. capture nsys + perfetto + kernel dispatch logs for each.
mia: also add a run with forced-kernel override at dispatch to see if forcing matmul_full removes gaps.
andrew: can someone own the matrix? target EOD tomorrow for initial signals.
zia: i'll run A/B/C/D on canary-3 and canary-5 and upload qdrep/html links here.
lila: i'll add runtime perfetto tracks: kv_cache.state, kv_sweep.start/end, prefetch.trigger, kernel.chosen_id.
dan: i'll produce a replay harness matching seq_len distribution so tests are deterministic.
ia: (bot) note: grep for chosen kernel in logs: ```grep \"chosen_kernel\" /var/log/redwood/runtime/*.log | tail -n 300``` helps surface flips.
mia: if the matrix still shows gaps, I'll prototype a small lock so kv_sweep defers eviction during active batch windows and we can A/B it.
andrew: also prepare an automatic rollback gate for that model variant if production token latency spikes. :thumbsup:
